security_subject_or_principal: Holder of an SCA certificate used to authenticate to the service
attacker_controlled_input_or_trigger: Certificate-derived identity/key accepted without sufficient scoping/constraints
decisive_security_relation: Mapping from certificate attributes to authorized identity is too permissive
required_validation_or_authorization_con: Tight validation and scoping of certificate usage to intended identities/contexts
security_sensitive_effect: Gain/abuse authenticated access beyond intended scope
